quest.rewards_formatted: Guide to Justice x2, Harra Fruit x3

dialogues.speaker: Foscari
dialogues.text: Thank you, my benefactor! God King be praised, I'm saved!

dialogues.speaker: Foscari
dialogues.text: Are you one of the legionnaires who defend this city? Or a valiant soul who happened by?

dialogues.speaker: Foscari
dialogues.text: In any case, allow me to introduce myself. Faustus am I, one of the Mercatores Exquisiti appointed by the God King himself.

dialogues.speaker: Foscari
dialogues.text: I came here to transport spices from the southern realms... I did not think that those vile vishaps would surround me the instant I came ashore...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Vishaps? I didn't see any vishaps.

dialogues.speaker: Foscari
dialogues.text: Hmm? My word, you truly are a mighty warrior — those foes were simply beneath your notice, I see!

dialogues.speaker: Foscari
dialogues.text: In any case, do take these. Yet I fear I must be short on pleasantries — these goods still need transporting into the city. Perhaps we shall meet again there.
